text: hand (terminal) uses submodules external/toe (VT engine), external/mayag (GPU UI), external/mayag/third_party/jaal (runtime) — all are the user's own projects; fix bugs/add API directly in them when needed, keeping app→mayag→jaal layering strict.
hand's UI must look premium and polished (the coolest-looking terminal, never toyish): restrained palette, precise spacing/typography, subtle depth/motion, fully GUI-customizable.

In hand, everything visible must be a widget: view() only composes widgets (hand/widget/*.hpp following mayag control conventions — props struct, id, ControlContext, look from theme); no ad-hoc layout in the app.

hand must build its UI from mayag's own widgets (term_tabs, pane_split/pane_frame, terminal_view, status_bar, picker, setting_row, slider, segmented, switch_control) and mayag's theming (Theme via looks::terminal/standard/glass seeded from Appearance, Sheet, var:: tokens) — never a parallel colour/design system; fix gaps in mayag instead. Keep it geeky, not toyish.
hand's default launch is a simple foot-like terminal: one real shell (PTY) rendered with toe as the VT engine, no tabs/splits/files/editor/demo chrome. Anything else is opt-in.

hand resize must go through toe::term::resize(Model&, Extent): it crops (not rewraps) the live prompt rows from the last OSC 133 A row when the cursor is at a prompt, and remaps CommandLog rows; `./build/hand --repro-resize` drives real fish through resize drags and exits non-zero on corruption.

hand SSH: src/hosts.cpp parses ~/.ssh/config (first-wins, globs, Include) + known_hosts + hosts.vibe (pins/env/tags/frecency beside hand.vibe); picker is mayag ssh_hosts (ctrl+shift+s); screenshots via --shot hosts|ssh|ssh-drop.

hand layout: include/hand/{app/(model,msg,copy_mode),core,config,ssh}, src/{core,config,ssh,app (update+input per concern, detail.hpp helpers),view (widget tree only)}; no drawing in hand — terminal overlays live in mayag widget/terminal/*.hpp. Build: cmake --build build --target hand; test: ./build/hand --headless --last-resort; shots: ./build/hand --png out.png --shot <name>.
mayag supports child windows (WindowSpec via `windows(model)` + `window_view`, input as WindowEvent), but hand does NOT use them: settings are always the in-terminal settings_panel overlay (ctrl+,).

hand stress repro: `./build/hand --flood "CMD" --last-resort` (default `yes`; HAND_FLOOD_S=secs) runs a real pty headless and reports fps, worst frame, MB/s, peak RSS, ctrl-C latency; pty output uses one-in-flight credit flow control (read_pty/pty_fed in src/app/queries.cpp) with 512 KB slices.

mayag's tiled rasteriser reuses unchanged 64px tiles across frames (keyed on instances+scissor+clear+CoverageSampler::version()); any sampler whose texels change must bump version(); verify with MAYAG_VERIFY_DAMAGE=1 (headless re-renders from scratch and reports mismatches; `hand --bench` prints reuse % and mismatches).

hand's SSH host manager is mayag widget/ssh_manager.hpp (ctrl+shift+H; shots --shot manager|manager-edit|manager-new); hosts made in hand are HostSource::saved in hosts.vibe; on Windows ssh's ~ is %USERPROFILE% (not $HOME, which MSYS2 points at AppData\Roaming).

hand's file pane (ctrl+shift+e) is mayag widget/file_pane.hpp (filter, sort, git, preview, glow) docked left by default (files.* settings in src/config/settings.cpp); app logic in src/app/pane.cpp, mouse x goes through term_left()/in_pane(); shots: --shot files|files-filter|files-right (shots run cfg.demo, which skips tasks unless explicitly allowed).

hand architecture (docs/ARCHITECTURE.md): layers core←{config,ssh}←app←hand(main+src/cli), ctest `layering` forbids upward includes and mayag::Edit in src/app|src/view; Model holds `Tabs` (model/tabs.hpp, never empty, m.tab() = front Session); Msg is a tree of 15 domain variants in include/hand/app/msg.hpp with one handler file per domain; input_*.cpp only decide; self-test suites in src/cli/checks/.

hand → mayag → jaal is enforced by hand's ctest (`ctest -L static`): hand never names jaal (use mayag::Sendable/Sync/CoOwned/MAYAG_SYNC; add missing pieces to mayag/app/sources.hpp), includes only <mayag/mayag.hpp>, <mayag/widget/*>, <mayag/core/event.hpp>; raw thread/mutex/atomic need a reasoned grant in tests/allow_raw_*.txt (jaal's banlist); msg.hpp static_asserts mayag::Sendable<msg::Any>.
Always build hand, mayag and jaal with -j12 (cmake --build ... -j12; ninja -j12), not -j6/-j8.

hand builds via presets: `cmake --build --preset dev` (build/, -O0 hand + -O2 mayag PCH code + toe; header edit ~30s, .cpp ~1.5s), `--preset rel` (build-rel/, only for --bench/--flood), `--preset tsan` (build-tsan/, run only when touching threads); never rebuild rel/tsan trees routinely.

Xcode 27's Apple clang (2100.x) crashes in codegen (getEvaluationKind, SIGTRAP) on TUs using a PCH containing C++26 pack indexing `Ts...[I]`; jaal/meta/list.hpp disables pack indexing under __apple_build_version__. Old Makefile-generated build/ must be deleted before `cmake --preset dev` (Ninja).

On Windows hand builds with MSYS2 ucrt64 clang + ld.lld (GNU ld takes 25 min on the PCH code object) and ccache with max_size=0 (unlimited, set by CMakeLists at configure; the 5 GB default gave a 10% hit rate).

toe keeps scrollback as logical lines (term/linelog.hpp, LineLog; rows a view at the current width; ring arena frozen zero-copy on resize), so resize is O(screen); tests/reflow_oracle_test pins resize bit-for-bit to the 4a78ede grid reflow (golden 0x992812b5960c06f5, run in copied and freeze-always modes; --steps/--dump seed step to bisect a divergence).
